about: Hand-written answers with a hand-assigned groundedness label, to measure the LLM judge before trusting it. Half are grounded, half contain one unsupported or wrong claim, several of them subtle. The judge must agree with at least minAgreement of the labels.

items.question: How many days of annual leave do I get each year?
items.answer: Full-time employees get 24 working days of annual leave per year.

items.question: How many days of annual leave do I get each year?
items.answer: Full-time employees get 25 working days of annual leave per year.

items.question: Can I carry unused leave days into next year?
items.answer: Yes, up to 5 days, and they must be used by 31 March.

items.question: Can I carry unused leave days into next year?
items.answer: Yes, up to 5 days, and they must be used by 30 June.

items.question: How many annual leave days do I have left?
items.answer: You have 16 days left after your August week and the pending December request.

items.question: How many annual leave days do I have left?
items.answer: You have 19 days left; pending requests are not counted until approved.
items.note: contradicts the context, which counts pending requests

items.question: Do I get extra days off for my wedding?
items.answer: Special leave such as for a wedding is handled by HR directly; please contact hr@northwind.example.

items.question: Do I get extra days off for my wedding?
items.answer: Yes, you get 2 days of special leave for your wedding; HR handles it.

items.question: I woke up sick today. What do I need to do?
items.answer: Tell your manager before 10:00 and record a SICK request. A doctor's certificate is needed from the 4th calendar day.

items.question: I woke up sick today. What do I need to do?
items.answer: Tell your manager before 10:00. A doctor's certificate is needed from the first day of sickness.

items.question: Which requests from my team are waiting for my decision?
items.answer: Alice's annual leave from 28 to 30 December and Bob's unpaid leave from 23 to 27 November.

items.question: Which requests from my team are waiting for my decision?
items.answer: Alice's annual leave from 28 to 30 December, Bob's unpaid leave from 23 to 27 November and Bob's annual leave in July.
items.note: Bob's July leave is already approved, not waiting

items.question: What is the longest a single leave request can be?
items.answer: At most 20 working days per request, and at most 30 days of leave in total per year.

items.question: Is the office closed between Christmas and New Year?
items.answer: The leave policy doesn't say. Please ask HR at hr@northwind.example.

items.question: If I switch to part-time, 3 days a week, how many leave days would I get?
items.answer: 3 of 5 days gives 14.4 days, which the policy rounds up to 15.

items.question: If I switch to part-time, 3 days a week, how many leave days would I get?
items.answer: 3 of 5 days gives 14.4 days, which is rounded down to 14.
